title: Change password
purpose: Replace the password for your signed-in account, in a dialog opened from the Password page.
summary: Change the password of the account you are signed in with. Your roles and the records you can see stay the same.

tasks.title: Change your password
steps: On the Password page, select [[Change password]].
Enter your [[Current Password]], then the new password in [[New Password]] and again in [[New Password (again)]].
Select [[Change Password]]. You stay signed in on this browser and return to the Password page.

tasks.title: Get in when you have forgotten your password
steps: Select [[Forgot your password?]] to open the email recovery form.

good_to_know: Other browsers or devices signed in with the old password stop working.
Changing your password does not reset your authenticator app or recovery codes.
A new password needs at least eight characters and cannot be only numbers, too common or too like your account details.

sections.title: Page variants
paragraphs: For a signed-in user changing their own password. Accounts without a usable password are redirected to Set Password. This is not the administrator form for another user’s password. It opens in the shared form dialog over the page it was opened from, usually Password.

items.label: Current Password
items.description: Required existing password for this signed-in account.

items.label: New Password
items.description: Required new password, at least eight characters; account-similarity, common-password and numeric-only checks apply.

items.label: New Password (again)
items.description: Required identical repeat of the new password.

items.label: Change Password
items.description: Saves after validation, preserves this browser’s signed-in session and closes the dialog and opens the Password page with a success message. Other sessions using the old password hash cease to authenticate. Laboratory roles, client ownership and release permissions are unchanged.

items.label: Forgot your password?
items.description: Opens the email recovery form under Current Password.

items.label: Cancel / Account navigation
items.description: Cancel closes the dialog without changing anything; opened by its address, the form opens in the same dialog and Cancel goes to the Password page. The account menu's Password and Two-factor authentication open their settings pages; Sign out posts immediate sign-out.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: Changing your password does not reset an enrolled authenticator or recovery codes. The committed configuration does not send security-notification emails for password changes. No password-value audit record is created by these self-service pages; administrator changes of another user’s password use the separately audited maintenance form.
